Market today: The mood is cautious for tech/chips, with Asian tech falling and AI names showing weakness. Jamie Dimon's leverage warning adds to the unease, directly impacting your margin-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-48.11%) and SPAL (-62.31%) are both leveraged, deeply in the red, and flagged "SELL"/"NEW" with broken stops. SMH (-10.48%) is flagged "TRIM." Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on broader tech sector performance and any further news on AI names, as these will dictate the direction of your concentrated portfolio.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions to protect capital.
plays: Your SOXL position is down 48.11% and flagged "SELL." Given its leveraged nature and deep loss, consider exiting or significantly reducing this position immediately.
Your new SPAL position is down 62.31% and also leveraged. This stop was clearly broken; consider exiting or significantly reducing this highly volatile position.
Your SMH is flagged "TRIM" and down 10.48%. While above its stop, consider trimming some exposure to reduce overall chip concentration.
